# WALLPAIR

> Paired wallpapers and widgets. Made for iPhone Duo.

WALLPAIR is an iPhone Duo app for matching Lock Screen and Home Screen wallpaper pairs and Home Screen widgets. Each Wall Pair is sized for iPhone Duo inner and outer displays. The app is free to start, with optional in-app purchases. There is no subscription.

## Product

- Name: WALLPAIR
- Platform: iOS, made for iPhone Duo
- Category: wallpapers and widgets
- Pricing: free wallpaper pairs; unlock more with in-app purchases; no subscription
- Website: https://wallpair.com/
- Support: https://wallpair.com/support
- Privacy: https://wallpair.com/privacy
- Contact: wallpair.support@gmail.com
- Developer: Wai Ho Tsang

## Features

- Matching Lock Screen and Home Screen wallpaper pairs
- Sized for iPhone Duo inner and outer displays
- Clock, weather, date and reminder widgets for Home Screen
- Curated collections
- Free pairs to start; pay only for what you pick

## FAQ

- What is WALLPAIR? An iPhone Duo app for paired Lock Screen and Home Screen wallpapers and matching widgets.
- Do wallpapers come in pairs? Yes. Matching Lock Screen and Home Screen wallpapers sized for inner and outer displays.
- What widgets are available? Clock, weather, date and reminder widgets for iPhone Duo Home Screen.
- Are there free wallpapers? Yes. Start with free pairs and unlock more with in-app purchases.
- Is there a subscription? No.
